explication: This is the Google APIs Client Library for PHP: application code configures a client and service, makes API operations, and receives response data as typed models. Its major capabilities include OAuth and service-account authentication, REST calls, batching, uploads, retry handling, and API service wrappers supplied by the separate google-api-php-client-services package. The graph uses documented workflow and sampled call references; relationships for unsampled token and REST internals are omitted rather than inferred.
